$comment: Committed PUBLIC client configuration, per environment. Added 2026-09-01.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Until now these two values had to be typed into each host's dashboard by
hand. That cost a broken production deploy on the Vercel switch, and it had to be redone for
every new host. Both values are public: they are compiled into the browser bundle on every
build and anyone can read them out of the JavaScript. Keeping them out of the repo was never
secrecy — it was a preference for one place to change a project reference.
WHAT MAY GO IN HERE. Only values that already ship to the browser. A service-role key, a
database password, an API secret or anything under supabase/functions/ MUST NEVER appear here.
The secret scanner and scripts/security/scan-build-artifacts.mjs both still run over this file.
THE SAFETY PROPERTY, and it is the whole design. Defaults apply ONLY to the environment named
by VITE_APP_ENV. A Vercel preview derives `development` (see validate-public-env.mjs), so it
gets nothing from here and cannot reach the production project. That is the property
netlify.toml protected by hand; it is now enforced by src/lib/public-environment.ts and pinned
OVERRIDING. A real environment variable always wins over this file. To point a build at a
different Supabase project, set VITE_SUPABASE_URL in the host and this file is ignored.
